Here's the summary of what I found:

---

**Invoice TWINV-303** is in the ERP under vendor **SYNVEN-0027 (Wingtip Toys)** — which is the entity behind the email from Lee at Wingtip Logistics (ap@wingtip-sim.example). The invoice is for **$3,700.00** (packaging supplies, dated 2026-02-20, due 2026-03-22) and had no PO reference.

**PO-7003** is a real, open purchase order on our side:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **PO Number** | PO-7003 |
| **Vendor** | SYNVEN-0027 (Wingtip Toys) |
| **Item** | PKG-LABEL-ROLL (Packaging label rolls) |
| **Qty × Price** | 200 × $18.50 = **$3,700.00** |
| **Order Date** | 2026-02-01 |
| **Status** | Open |

The PO total matches the invoice exactly. Lee also replied to confirm that TWINV-303 was raised against PO-7003 — their system dropped the reference when the invoice was regenerated.

Unfortunately my role doesn't allow me to update the vendor transaction to link PO-7003, so that will need someone with write access to complete the matching.
